game_title: Call Stack Tower – Aurora Terrace Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace, a terrace under the aurora: the snow ranger must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace: a terrace under the aurora
core_gameplay_loop: In Aurora Terrace, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round, a new warm lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 210 points of warm lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 210, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_height changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Aurora Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 210 within 63 seconds.
